sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "As Sniper likes to say: "The best tool against a sniper is another sniper". It is not a rare case in combat, but you have to keep in mind that the enemy is a well-trained and well-prepared shooter. They are smart, will take up tricky positions, and try to deceive you. Even if they're not a professional military man, but a former gamekeeper or so. You need to "tie down" the enemy sniper, make them show themself - then, they're all yours. Well, these are recommendations I was asked to give you. Scavs just find rifles with scopes and climb up on the roofs or rocks, thinking they're actual snipers. Those are the ones you have to eliminate."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 Sniper Scavs while using a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +13,100 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 85,000 Roubles
  - 89,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 97,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock
- 1× Ski hat with holes for eyes
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock at Jaeger LL3
"There are no foul tricks in the sniper play. Good work, kid."
